title: A Study to Learn About the Study Medicine Called PF-07248144 in Combination With Fulvestrant in People With HR-positive, HER2-negative Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer Who Progressed After a Prior Line of Treatment.

rules.rule_text: Confirmed diagnosis of HR-positive HER2-negative breast cancer with locally advanced or metastatic disease not amenable to surgical resection or radiation with curative intent
rules.source_text: Confirmed diagnosis of HR-positive HER2-negative breast cancer with evidence of locally advanced or metastatic disease, which is not amenable to surgical resection or radiation therapy with curative intent.

rules.rule_text: Prior CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy in combination with endocrine therapy in advanced metastatic setting or in adjuvant setting with documented progression during or within 12 months after last dose
rules.source_text: Prior CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy in combination with endocrine therapy in advance metastatic setting or in adjuvant setting with documented progression during or within 12 months after the last dose of CDK4/6i.

rules.rule_text: Previously received CDK4/6i or endocrine therapy as monotherapy or in combination for rechallenge in advanced or metastatic setting
rules.source_text: Participants are eligible if they previously received CDK4/6i or ET as a monotherapy, or in combination for rechallenge therapy in the advance or metastatic setting

rules.rule_text: Have received prior therapy targeting estrogen receptor 1 (ESR1) or BRCA1/2
rules.source_text: have received prior therapy targeting estrogen receptor 1 (ESR1) or breast cancer gene (BRCA)1/2.

rules.rule_text: Measurable disease per RECIST v.1.1 or non-measurable bone-only disease
rules.source_text: Measurable disease evaluable per Response Evaluation Criterion in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v.1.1 or non-measurable bone-only disease
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status (PS) 0 or 1.

rules.rule_text: Documented detectable PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN alterations in tissue
rules.source_text: Documented detectable PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN alterations in tissue

rules.rule_text: Received greater than two prior lines of systemic therapy in advanced or metastatic setting
rules.source_text: Received greater than two prior lines of systemic therapy in the advance or metastatic setting

rules.rule_text: Prior chemotherapy in advanced or metastatic setting
rules.source_text: Had received any prior chemotherapy, including antibody drug conjugates (ADCs), in advance or metastatic setting.

rules.rule_text: Any medical or psychiatric condition that may increase the risk of study participation or make the participant inappropriate for the study
rules.source_text: Any medical or psychiatric condition that may increase the risk of study participation or make the participant inappropriate for the study.

rules.rule_text: Renal impairment, hepatic dysfunction, or hematologic abnormalities
rules.source_text: Renal impairment, hepatic dysfunction, or hematologic abnormalities.
